crossRefs.note: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But…
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?
For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things…
But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for…
which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?
Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

translations.web: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
translations.bsb: It is not only the old who are wise, or the elderly who understand justice.
translations.kjv: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
translations.asv: It is not the great that are wise, Nor the aged that understand justice.
